sorular.soru: Good character is more than just looking good. Which of the following is part of what good character truly encompasses?
secenekler: A) Being polite in public but hurtful at home
B) Only performing acts of worship completely
C) Being popular among people
D) Speaking truthfully, controlling anger and honoring trusts
sorular.aciklama: Good character is shown by speaking truthfully, looking down on no one, controlling anger, honoring trusts, being forgiving and not harming others.

sorular.soru: What did the Prophet say would be among the heaviest things on the scales on the Day of Judgment?
secenekler: A) Performing a great deal of salah
B) Good character
C) A long life
D) Having great wealth
sorular.aciklama: Good character is more than social politeness; it is also a great asset for the Hereafter.

sorular.soru: What is especially emphasized as the standard for good character?
secenekler: A) The example of the Messenger of Allah
B) General social acceptance
C) The expectations of those around us
D) The fashion of the time
sorular.aciklama: When learning good character, the standard is the example of the Messenger of Allah, not what is fashionable among people.

sorular.soru: What is the fundamental difference between justice and ihsan?
secenekler: A) They mean exactly the same thing
B) Justice concerns iman, while ihsan concerns worship
C) Justice is giving people their due, while ihsan is giving them their due and completing the good deed with excellence
D) Ihsan is a lower degree than justice
sorular.aciklama: Justice is giving everyone their due; ihsan is not only giving people their due but also completing the good deed with excellence.

sorular.soru: Truthfulness is more than not telling lies. Which of the following is also part of truthfulness?
secenekler: A) Telling the truth when it brings a benefit
B) Being honest with those in power
C) Being honest only in official matters
D) Keeping one's word and honoring trusts
sorular.aciklama: Truthfulness gains its full meaning through keeping one's word, not betraying trusts and not giving incomplete or distorted information.

sorular.soru: Why is lying seen as a great danger?
secenekler: A) Because a small corruption in speech can eventually corrupt one's character
B) Because it has only legal consequences
C) Because people notice it immediately
D) Because it applies only to business
sorular.aciklama: A Muslim does not use lies for short-term gain, because a small corruption in speech can eventually corrupt one's character.

sorular.soru: What aspect of good conduct in speech does the principle “Speak good or remain silent” teach?
secenekler: A) Those who talk a lot are considered more respectable
B) Every thought should be shared openly
C) One should avoid idle, hurtful and divisive speech
D) Silence is always the best solution
sorular.aciklama: The tongue is the doorway through which the iman, anger, arrogance or mercy in the heart finds expression. Good character requires controlling this doorway.

sorular.soru: Which three questions are recommended before speaking?
secenekler: A) Is it pleasant, interesting and new?
B) Is it true, necessary and polite?
C) Is it brief, quick and effective?
D) Is it useful to everyone, entertaining and memorable?
sorular.aciklama: For good conduct in speech, this three-part assessment is recommended: Is what I am about to say true, necessary and polite?

sorular.soru: How does the Quran regard one group mocking another, finding fault with people and calling them offensive names?
secenekler: A) It regards them as jokes
B) It considers them minor faults
C) It forbids them only toward strangers
D) It clearly forbids them
sorular.aciklama: Looking down on someone is sometimes disguised as a joke, but a joke that hurts someone's feelings is not good character.

sorular.soru: Which statement about a joke that hurts someone's feelings is true?
secenekler: A) There is no responsibility because it is a joke
B) It is always acceptable among close friends
C) If it belittles someone, it is not considered good character
D) Hurt feelings go away on their own over time
sorular.aciklama: A joke that belittles someone or hurts their feelings is not considered good character. A believer rises by valuing others.

sorular.soru: What does backbiting mean?
secenekler: A) Saying something about someone behind their back that they would dislike
B) Saying hurtful words to someone's face
C) Criticizing someone in public
D) Judging someone unfairly
sorular.aciklama: Backbiting is saying something about someone behind their back that they would dislike. The Quran describes it with the powerful comparison of eating the flesh of one's dead brother.

sorular.soru: Negative assumptions, looking for hidden faults and backbiting are forbidden together in the Quran. What danger do all three share?
secenekler: A) They constitute legal offenses
B) They stain the heart and damage trust
C) They harm only those close to us
D) They cause social unrest
sorular.aciklama: Negative assumptions without evidence create distrust in the heart; looking for others' hidden faults damages the spirit of brotherhood; and backbiting stains the heart.

sorular.soru: How does the Quran describe people of taqwa in relation to their anger?
secenekler: A) As people who never get angry
B) As people who constantly express their anger
C) As people who restrain their anger and forgive others
D) As people who direct their anger at others
sorular.aciklama: The Quran praises people of taqwa as those who restrain their anger and forgive others.

sorular.soru: What advice did the Prophet repeatedly give to a Companion who asked for advice?
secenekler: A) Make a great deal of supplication
B) Shout at people
C) Make decisions hastily
D) Do not become angry
sorular.aciklama: By advising, “Do not become angry,” the Messenger of Allah emphasized that controlling anger is a powerful step in serving Allah.

sorular.soru: Which response is recommended as helpful when one is angry?
secenekler: A) Remaining silent and not judging hastily
B) Immediately making a firm decision
C) Raising one's voice to gain the upper hand
D) Responding immediately to everything the other person says
sorular.aciklama: When angry, one is advised to remain silent, avoid hasty decisions and delay a hurtful response.

sorular.soru: What does forgiveness not mean?
secenekler: A) Not escalating revenge
B) Having to regard wrongdoing as acceptable in every situation
C) Not becoming harsh out of personal resentment
D) Aiming to reform and soften the situation
sorular.aciklama: Forgiveness means being able to restrain oneself from revenge, not legitimizing wrongdoing.

sorular.soru: According to the Quran, what may happen when evil is met with the best response?
secenekler: A) The other person will change immediately
B) This approach always works
C) Enmity may turn into friendship over time
D) One's rights will be lost
sorular.aciklama: The Quran says that repelling evil with the best response can turn even someone who bears enmity into a warm friend.

sorular.soru: What is humility?
secenekler: A) Seeing oneself as worthless
B) Withdrawing in every situation
C) Never expressing one's own opinions
D) Recognizing the blessings Allah has given without looking down on people because of them
sorular.aciklama: Humility is recognizing the blessings Allah has given without looking down on people because of them. Arrogance is the exact opposite.

sorular.soru: Which behavior is clearly condemned in Surah Luqman of the Quran?
secenekler: A) Treating people arrogantly and turning one's face away from them
B) Working hard
C) Remaining silent
D) Helping neighbors
sorular.aciklama: Surah Luqman commands people not to turn their faces away from others and not to walk arrogantly on the earth.

sorular.soru: What does the Quran advise about walking and speaking?
secenekler: A) Walk quickly and speak loudly
B) Walk differently to attract attention
C) Be moderate in your walking and do not raise your voice unnecessarily
D) Speaking by shouting is effective
sorular.aciklama: Calmness, balance, and moderation are among the outward expressions of good character. Harshness and shouting do not strengthen words; on the contrary, they make them unpleasant.

sorular.soru: What does the hadith "Show mercy to those on earth so that the One in heaven may show mercy to you" teach?
secenekler: A) That mercy should be shown only to relatives
B) The connection between a servant's mercy and divine mercy
C) That mercy is the same as the act of zakat
D) That mercy is directed only toward the weak
sorular.aciklama: It has been stated that the Most Merciful will show mercy to those who show mercy. Mercy brings a person closer both to their Lord and to His servants.

sorular.soru: What does mercy mean?
secenekler: A) Only feeling pity
B) Accepting every request without question
C) Only providing financial help
D) Recognizing another person's needs and treating them kindly
sorular.aciklama: Mercy is not merely feeling pity; it is recognizing another person's needs and treating them kindly.

sorular.soru: How did the Prophet ﷺ describe the best of people?
secenekler: A) Those who treat their families best
B) Those who perform the most acts of worship
C) Those who hold the highest positions
D) Those who live the longest
sorular.aciklama: It has been stated that the best of people are those who treat their families best. Family life is a test of the sincerity of one's character.

sorular.soru: Why is family life considered a "sincerity test" of one's character?
secenekler: A) Rules are stricter at home
B) Family members can be deceived more easily
C) True character is tested by remaining good at home as well as outside
D) Relationships outside the home are unimportant
sorular.aciklama: People sometimes behave most recklessly toward those they love most. Therefore, being polite outside but hurtful at home is not true good character.

sorular.soru: What did the Prophet ﷺ say about a person whose neighbor is not safe from their harm?
secenekler: A) That they should be patient until their neighbor changes
B) That there is a serious deficiency in their iman
C) That it is enough to apologize to their neighbor
D) That it would be better for them to move
sorular.aciklama: A believer is someone who gives their neighbor and those around them a sense of safety. It has been stated in striking terms that there is a serious deficiency in the iman of one who disturbs their neighbor.

sorular.soru: How did the Prophet ﷺ describe modesty?
secenekler: A) As social shyness
B) As a quality exclusive to women
C) As a sign of weakness
D) As a part of iman
sorular.aciklama: Modesty is part of iman. It leads a person to feel a sense of shame before Allah, abandon what is unbecoming, and observe boundaries.

sorular.soru: What etiquette does the Quran teach for entering someone else's home?
secenekler: A) Ask permission and give greetings first
B) Enter quietly
C) Enter without knocking
D) Enter only during the day
sorular.aciklama: This is not just etiquette at the door; it teaches respect for personal space, privacy, and consideration.

sorular.soru: How did the Prophet ﷺ describe smiling at one's brother?
secenekler: A) An empty courtesy
B) Only a Sunnah
C) Charity
D) A waste of time
sorular.aciklama: Good character does not consist only of great sacrifices; even acts of kindness considered small can win many hearts.

sorular.soru: Which statement about small acts of kindness is correct?
secenekler: A) They have no effect because they are small
B) Even acts of kindness considered small can win many hearts
C) Only financial help has value
D) Only great sacrifices are meaningful
sorular.aciklama: Removing something harmful from a path, giving directions, and greeting others with a smile are everyday opportunities to show good character.

sorular.soru: How does good character develop?
secenekler: A) It forms instantly by listening to a single piece of advice
B) Only by being careful in a crowd
C) By preparing for great sacrifices
D) It becomes established through small, conscious choices repeated over time
sorular.aciklama: Good character does not develop in a single day; it grows stronger by paying attention to one area each day and reflecting on one's conduct.

sorular.soru: What three daily steps are recommended for developing good character?
secenekler: A) Reflect on one's conduct, repent and make amends, and remember the example of the Messenger of Allah
B) Talk a lot, listen a lot, and write a lot
C) Only read books
D) Focus on major acts of worship
sorular.aciklama: Reflecting on one's conduct at the end of the day, repenting and making amends when one makes a mistake, and frequently remembering the example of the Messenger of Allah strengthen good character.

sorular.soru: How is the relationship between good character and acts of worship described?
secenekler: A) They are two completely independent areas
B) Acts of worship do not require good character
C) Good character is the fruit of worship reflected in daily life
D) Good character takes the place of worship
sorular.aciklama: A Muslim's character is not separate from their acts of worship; it is the fruit of worship reflected in daily life.

sorular.soru: When is good character tested most?
secenekler: A) When people are watching you
B) In moments of anger or difficulty
C) When you win and are at the height of your power
D) At religious gatherings
sorular.aciklama: Remaining silent when angry, forgiving, and responding to evil with kindness are among the hardest and most valuable tests of good character.

sorular.soru: Which of the following is one of the main behaviors that harm good character?
secenekler: A) Being self-critical
B) Performing acts of kindness quietly
C) Admitting mistakes
D) Focusing on others' faults without correcting oneself
sorular.aciklama: A person who focuses on correcting their own faults instead of those of others makes faster progress on the path of good character.

sorular.soru: Which of the following is not one of the fundamental aspects of good character?
secenekler: A) Arrogance and looking down on others
B) Honesty and trustworthiness
C) Mercy and forgiveness
D) Politeness in speech and modesty
sorular.aciklama: Arrogance is not a part of good character; it is one of the foremost diseases that harm it.
